pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large pot and fill it with water.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Put the pot of water on the stove and turn on the stove at high heat.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Add one tablespoon of salt to the water.
Instruct: Take about 200 grams of pasta and add it to the water.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: While the water boils and the pasta cooks, take a large pan, put it on the stove and put about two tablespoons of olive oil into it, to coat the bottom of the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take two cloves of garlic and chop them up.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: You can now add the chopped garlic to the pan which is coated with oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the stove with the pan with oil and chopped garlic. Set the heat to medium.
Instruct: Now take about one cup of crushed tomatoes and add it to the pan with the chopped garlic. Make sure to use the measuring cup.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now let the tomato sauce and the garlic simmer for a bit. Next, keep checking if the pasta is cooked. It should cut/break easily with a fork if cooked.
Instruct: Now you can use the lid of the pot to drain the water, but make sure to set aside around half cup of pasta water using the measuring cup.
Instruct: Now add the pasta to the pan with the tomato paste and garlic.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Add the pasta water in the measuring cup to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now take a spoon and mix the pasta with the tomato garlic sauce thoroughly.
Instruct: Now you can add the grated Parmesan cheese on top of the pasta. Add at least four tablespoons of grated Parmesan.
Instruct: Now mix the pasta and the cheese together.
